XGBoost Multimodal.dataset_provenance: 200 synthetic 23-feature fusion samples. 0 genuinely paired clinical records.
XGBoost Multimodal.known_limitations: Labels are rule-derived research categories, not clinical severity. 0 genuinely paired patient records. HIGH class support on test is 3. Not clinical.

Experimental 4-Qubit VQC.dataset_provenance: Same 200 synthetic fusion samples as XGBoost. 0 clinical pairs.
Experimental 4-Qubit VQC.known_limitations: Classical simulator only. Held-out 16/30 vs XGBoost 25/30. Isolated from SOS, first-aid, and main decisions. Quantum advantage not claimed.
Experimental 4-Qubit VQC.notes: EXPERIMENTAL_ONLY. Isolated from main decision. Training circuit equals inference circuit. DATA_PROVENANCE=SYNTHETIC.

EfficientNetV2 Classification.dataset_provenance: public_wound_dataset classification images. Held-out test n=30. Not paired clinical records. Forensic audit: images are synthetic PIL drawings, not downloaded clinical photos.
EfficientNetV2 Classification.known_limitations: Held-out accuracy 1.0 on 30 images coexists with blank-image collapse to swelling (~0.96–1.0 raw softmax). Quality gates withhold blanks; they are not a clinical filter. Swelling is not a YOLO class. 2026-08-29 candidate (2-class unique-hash drawings) was not promoted: remaining OOD probes still collapse to an injury class at >=0.95.
EfficientNetV2 Classification.notes: Status and metrics come from efficientnetv2_metadata.json after real training.

ResNet34-UNet Segmentation.dataset_provenance: HuggingFace subbareddyoota/wseg_dataset CC-BY-NC-4.0 (338 unique subsampled pairs) + UWM Medetec_foot_ulcer_224 (152 pairs) + 31 SYNTHETIC_EMPTY_TARGET canvases. Hash-disjoint splits. Not sports-injury cut/bruise/swelling.
ResNet34-UNet Segmentation.known_limitations: Research-demo binary wound segmentation on chronic/foot-ulcer photographs. Not clinically validated. Not a cut/bruise/swelling localizer. Empty canvases are synthetic, not healthy-skin photos. Previous checkpoint SHA 2b4967aa... kept as unet_injury_best.pt.pre_public_real_backup.
ResNet34-UNet Segmentation.notes: Status and metrics come from unet_metadata.json after real training.

metrics.metrics_source: ultralytics.val on yolo_retrain_v2 test split (promoted candidate)

YOLO11 Detection.notes: Single runtime checkpoint YOLO_CANONICAL. Classes are model.names. Any class not in model.names is UNTRAINED_CLASS. Backups are not loaded.
YOLO11 Detection.known_limitations: Independent test support is 8 cut boxes and 10 bruise boxes on mostly synthetic drawings. That is not enough to claim cut or bruise reliability. wound has 0 honest training boxes. abrasion/laceration/swelling remain UNTRAINED_CLASS. Default keep-threshold 0.25. Demo football_injury.jpg has 0 boxes at 0.25. Not clinical.
YOLO11 Detection.dataset_provenance: yolo_retrain_v2 copied from yolo_processed (honest cut/bruise, dropped abrasion/laceration/swelling without remap) plus existing blank_skin (val) and dummy_test (test) empty-label negatives. No fabricated images or boxes. wound has 0 labels.

Sensor Motion Event Classifier.dataset_provenance: Generated by prepare_sensor_dataset() with np.random over 38 synthetic subject IDs. Schema is SisFall/UCI-HAR-like (50 Hz windows). Not downloaded SisFall or UCI HAR recordings.
Sensor Motion Event Classifier.known_limitations: Simulated football_fall can classify as normal_activity at high confidence. Missing gyro/lux features are FEATURE_MISSING, never invented. Not a fall-detection medical device.
Sensor Motion Event Classifier.notes: Called from sensor_processor. Missing features are reported, never invented.

immediate_first_aid_steps: Clean the open area gently with clean water, apply a sterile protective dressing, and apply light pressure if bleeding is active.
Rest the affected area in a comfortable, elevated position and consider applying a wrapped cold compress for 15–20 minutes.
actions_to_avoid: Avoid forcing joint movement or aggressively testing weight-bearing capacity.
Avoid applying unsterile powders, home remedies, or touching open wound edges with unwashed hands.
Avoid continuing sport, running, or heavy physical activity while pain or swelling persists.
symptoms_to_monitor: Monitor for expanding redness, localized warmth, or increasing tissue swelling over the next 24–48 hours.
Watch for infection indicators such as pus, drainage, red streaks, or systemic fever.
Observe pain trends over time (note if pain score progresses from mild to severe).
professional_evaluation_guidance: Based on the reported warning signs, professional medical evaluation is recommended.
limitations: AI-QTriage is an academic research prototype. Model outputs are experimental and are not a medical diagnosis. An image model failing to detect an injury does not mean that no injury is present.
